message.content:
Deep charcoal wool blazer, relaxed cut, knee-length, slate gray (#4B4F56), heavy wool
Oatmeal cashmere turtleneck sweater, slim fit, hip-length, soft beige (#E8E4DC), fine-gauge knit
Mid-thigh dark navy straight-leg trousers, wide leg, charcoal black (#1C1D20), structured cotton twill
Classic low-oxford two-tone shoes in black and dark brown, round toe, #302D2B, polished leather
Matte black ceramic signet ring, simple band, jet black (#000000), sterling silver with onyx stone

This outfit honors the solemnity of your grandfather's funeral while adhering strictly to your request for a deep, dark autumn palette that avoids anything light or casual. The heavy wool and cotton fabrics provide necessary warmth for the cooler weather without appearing stiff, allowing you to move comfortably through the service. By choosing a relaxed blazer cut and soft cashmere, the ensemble balances respect with personal comfort, reflecting your desire to feel dignified yet at ease during this difficult time.
